parsed.internal_thinking: Ziv is really trying to put a target on my back. With 4 points, I am indeed one point away from winning, but I lack the אבן (ore) to build a city or the resources for another settlement right now. The 8 was great for my חיטה (wheat) and כבשה (sheep) supply, but I need to downplay my lead so they don't block me or use the robber against me. Shon's betrayal is still in my mind, so I need to be careful with him too.
parsed.note_to_self: Ziv is actively rallying the table against me. I need 2 אבן and 1 more חיטה to upgrade to a city and win. I have 2 כבשה and 1 עץ that I can potentially trade.
parsed.say_outloud: זיו, בסך הכל יצא 8, זה לא אומר שסגרתי את המשחק. אל תשכח שיש לך עיר על המגרש, אתה ממש לא מאחור.
